name: Context-aware trees
scope: Train on the other complete binary sample and Dataset 2. Shared genes and coordinates are allowed; held-out sample labels are excluded from all fitting.
context_checks: Keep half the held-out sites, or sites at or above median coverage; recompute only observed other-site context. Compare the same retained sites with their full-context scores.
selection: Recipe and blend selected using internal and external development comparisons; not an untouched final test.
ordering: Dataset 2 levels specify within-position order, not calibrated site probabilities.
